toml:
# LEO-PNT focus area: MEO + LEO fused PNT.
#
# A receiver in Madrid fuses GPS, Galileo and the Xona Pulsar X5 signal (public signal
# table, arXiv 2509.19551; the inclined 1080 km shell) in one weighted least-squares
# pseudorange solution with an inter-system bias per system. How good must the LEO orbit
# and clock be for the LEO layer to help? The campaign sweeps the LEO signal-in-space
# range error (SISRE) from 5 cm to 5 m and records the root-mean-square (RMS) 3D error of
# the GNSS-only, LEO-only and fused solutions over half an hour, and the fused median
# position dilution of precision (PDOP).
#
# The GNSS-only solution does not change; the fused one approaches it when the LEO SISRE
# is metres and improves on it by the LEO geometry when the SISRE is decimetres: the
# broadcast-message and orbit-determination quality (see `leo-pnt-end-to-end`, which
# hands the navigation message's SISRE to this stage) decides whether fusing pays.
#
# MODELLED: stated per-system SISRE and loop noise from C/N0; no multipath.
kind = "campaign"
title = "Fused MEO + LEO positioning against the LEO SISRE"
seed = 20260929

[sweep]
metrics = [
  { name = "gnss_rms_3d", path = "joint.gnss.rms_error_3d_m" },
  { name = "leo_rms_3d", path = "joint.leo.rms_error_3d_m" },
  { name = "fused_rms_3d", path = "joint.fused.rms_error_3d_m" },
  { name = "fused_median_pdop", path = "joint.fused.median_pdop" },
]

[[sweep.axes]]
name = "leo_sisre"
key = "system.2.sisre_m"
unit = "m"
start = 0.05
stop = 5.0
steps = 7
scale = "log"

[sweep.scenario]
kind = "leo-pvt"
mode = "joint"
seed = 3
duration_s = 1800.0
step_s = 30.0

[sweep.scenario.user]
lat_deg = 40.42
lon_deg = -3.70
height_m = 650.0

[[sweep.scenario.system]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]
sisre_m = 0.6

[[sweep.scenario.system]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]
sisre_m = 0.3
isb_ns = 12.0

[[sweep.scenario.system]]
name = "Pulsar X5"
leo_preset = "xona-pulsar"
signal = "X5"
sisre_m = 0.5
isb_ns = 40.0
